status: Frozen v1 candidate wire contract for implementation review; hardware and physical qualification remain open. Change semantic layout only by versioned replacement.
encoding: Little-endian; fixed 20-byte values; compatible with ATT_MTU 23. Reserved bits and fields must be zero.
security: Plug GATT server must require authenticated/encrypted access according to the separately qualified pairing policy; NINA client cannot impose security on an unsecured server attribute.
independent_transport: PC native USB and ROM recovery have no radio, bridge, reset or power dependency. The D+/D- path is physically direct.

fields.name: raw_ratio_q16
fields.meaning: Optional dimensionless thermistor ratio: integer divided by 65536; 0xffff is reserved as invalid. It is not raw ADC counts and does not automatically establish temperature validity.

rules: Publish each distinct NTC attempt with its original start and completion ticks, including invalid attempts.
Never restamp a cached 1 Hz sample at a 100 ms UI tick.
Invalid data cannot refresh the last valid sample age.
The receiver computes age from the mapped acquisition tick and current case monotonic time, including time-anchor uncertainty.
Flags report observations and candidates, not SOC or a new Ready state.
Bare CHG high with zero ISET never means Done.
Sample CHG locally every 25 ms or faster and retain edge history. Approximately 2 Hz faults cannot be inferred from 1 Hz notifications alone.
On failed I2C, ADC or configuration readback, publish invalid status; do not reuse the last value as fresh.
ISET, TS, VBAT and valid CHG/CE/PGOOD observations form an acquisition bundle spanning at most 250 ms and ending at sample_completed_ms. Clear validity for any field outside that window.
sample_completed_ms is the actual acquisition-group completion tick, not the BLE publication tick. Continuous CHG fault history remains independent of the bundled snapshot.
PGOOD loss is a source-loss candidate, never confirmation of physical removal.
The first post-loss attempt must begin after the loss observation. A cached or already-running conversion does not qualify.
Match event timestamps to the thermal attempt history. Missing records or wrap ambiguity invalidate inferred baselines.
Retain reconnection before the first new attempt separately from reconnection before the first valid temperature.
No charger CE control, UV safety override or USB mode switch opcode.
ATT write success confirms transport only. Wait for command_result with the matching request_id and case_session_id_echo.
Commands are idempotent by case_session_id/request_id. Duplicates must not create a second baseline event.
Never reuse a request_id within the same case_session_id. Establish a new session nonce before exhausting the 16-bit request-ID space.

case_session_id is a fresh 32-bit transport nonce initialized at case boot and rotated before any request-ID reuse. It is not the plug sensor boot identifier. Its producer must ensure freshness in the comparison window using a qualified persistent counter or qualified entropy. If freshness cannot be established, command correlation and time anchoring remain invalid.

fields.name: case_session_id_echo
fields.meaning: Exact echo of the case transport-session nonce, not a result payload. It must match the current pending request, including the first time anchor.

rules: The time anchor uses case request-send/result-receive ticks and plug received_ms/completed_ms. Retain the offset interval and its uncertainty.
No wall-clock or UTC guarantee exists without an independent case time source or a PC anchor.
Link to source_event by event_sequence, plug_boot_id and observed_loss_ms. Never overwrite the distinct first-attempt record.
Identify the first valid sample in the thermal attempt history; invalid attempts cannot populate these timestamps.
Reconnection before a valid post-loss sample remains distinguishable from reconnection before any post-loss attempt.

transport_limits.bridge: SC16IS750: 64-byte FIFO, 115200 8N1, actual automatic RTS/CTS. A continuous line-rate stream can fill the FIFO in 5.56 ms.
not_guaranteed: BLE availability in ROM recovery or C3reset
case ambient temperature from radio die sensor
transport_limits.reconnect: Read a fresh snapshot and missing bounded event sequence. A plug boot-ID change invalidates timing/history across that boundary. Modular ordering is valid only within the half-range window of the same known boot.
transport_limits.limits: Twenty-byte values avoid a larger-MTU dependency. Separate characteristics are not an atomic snapshot; check boot, sequence, timing and validity.

decode_rules: Reject values not exactly 20 bytes, unsupported versions and nonzero reserved bits. A failed decode cannot refresh any freshness timestamp.
Flags determine availability. Tick 0 and sequence 0 are valid after wrap; numeric zero is not an invalid sentinel.
An invalid numeric sentinel with its validity flag set is malformed. Invalidate that field and report a protocol fault; retain prior valid data without restamping it.

temperature_valid requires attempt_completed and a noninvalid tip value. raw_ratio_valid requires attempt_completed and a noninvalid ratio, independently of temperature_valid. An absent ratio does not invalidate an otherwise valid temperature.
Invalid charge numeric fields must carry 0xffff. Decode observations only; infer no Done, SOC or Ready state. CHG, CE and PGOOD each have independent validity.
Link source-attempt and first-valid records by boot ID, event sequence and loss tick. Reordered or missing records cannot create a synthetic complete baseline.

After plug boot change, reconnect, unknown ordering or an excessive gap, invalidate cross-boot timing and require a fresh snapshot/time anchor. Boot IDs are correlation identifiers, not authentication.
Use uint16 sequence and uint32 tick modular ordering only for a known same boot and a span smaller than half the respective modulus. Larger or ambiguous gaps invalidate ordering.
Compute age from actual acquisition time and the case/plug time-anchor uncertainty. Receipt of a delayed notification cannot make a sample fresh.
A cache may expose fresh, aged or unknown data but cannot invent thermal readiness or charge-completion thresholds.
time_anchor_rules: Allow at most one outstanding time-anchor request per case session. Match request_id, exact case_session_id_echo and current plug_boot_id. Clear pending requests on disconnect or either session/boot change.

The case records monotonic transmit T0 and complete-result receive T3. The plug returns monotonic receive T1 and completion T2. After wrap-safe conversion, the plug-minus-case offset lies in [T2-T3, T1-T0]. Reject an interval whose lower bound exceeds its upper bound.
Uncertainty includes the whole interval and timer resolution. Assume no fixed BLE latency. The implementation must state its overdue-result policy.
Map a sample to the case clock only when its boot and tick window match a valid anchor. Otherwise its age is unknown. Monotonic ticks are not UTC.
Duplicate commands are idempotent by case_session_id/request_id. After bounded idempotency-history eviction, return history_unavailable rather than recreate a baseline.
A retained result from an earlier case session must never satisfy a new request, even when its 16-bit request ID and plug boot ID match. Check case_session_id_echo first.
